shapes.name: pill
shapes.description: Pill controls and fields, deep card and dialog corners, round avatars, and an edge whose colors turn slowly round the element once every six seconds. It stops for reduced motion and when the page pauses motion.

shapes.name: round
shapes.description: Generous radii with a 2px edge that fades from the muted foreground color into the foreground color. Nested corners are the outer radius less the 8px inset and the edge, so they stay concentric.

shapes.name: sharp
shapes.description: Square corners everywhere, with a thin muted rule as the edge. Reads technical and printed, like a ledger or a newspaper.

shapes.name: soft
shapes.description: Small radii that grow with the surface: 4px controls, 12px cards, 16px dialogs, round avatars. No edge; surfaces and shadows show the boundaries.

shapes.name: squircle
shapes.description: Continuous corners, the squircle of app icons, where the browser supports corner-shape, and plain round corners of the same radius elsewhere. Avatars stay circles.

decl.name: dotted-frame
decl.description: A frame of dots repeated along every edge, painted in the muted foreground color, sitting half outside the element.

decl.name: halo-around
decl.description: A broken ring around the element, an avatar decoration, in the link color, 6px outside it and turning once every twelve seconds. Reduced motion stops it.

decl.name: holly-corners
decl.description: Holly leaves with red berries at each corner, in the drawing's own colors, swaying gently on a four-second cycle. Reduced motion leaves it still.

decl.name: leaf-corners
decl.description: A fallen maple leaf at each corner in the drawing's own autumn colors, bobbing slowly on a five-second cycle. Reduced motion leaves it still.

decl.name: snow-corners
decl.description: A snowflake at each corner in the muted foreground color, twinkling once every 2.4 seconds, well under three flashes a second. Reduced motion leaves it still.

decl.name: spark-traveller
decl.description: A small four-point star in the link color that travels round the element's border every eight seconds. Without offset-path support, or with reduced motion, it rests at the top left corner.

decl.name: sprig-corners
decl.description: A small leafy sprig at each corner, painted in the link color, reaching 6px outside the element. Still.

seasons.name: northern-year
seasons.description: A northern-hemisphere year: sprigs in spring, falling leaves in autumn, holly on cards and a ring round avatars over the winter holidays, and snow until the end of February. Nothing is drawn between seasons.
